v2_human_g3_constraints.c_1: The system must be a single function implemented in python
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_2: The system must determine feasibility only using the provided inputs
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_3: The system assumes inputs are in a reasonable and consistent format
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_4: The system shall not exceed any resources available capacity to determine feasibility
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_5: An allocation is not valid if all resources are fully used
v2_human_g3_constraints.c_6: The same inputs should always give the same output

v2_human_g3_fr.fr_1: The system shall provide a function that evaluates the feasibility of resource allocation
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_2: The system shall accept an input of a set of available resources and resource requests
v2_human_g3_fr.fr_3: The system shall return True if all requests are satisfied, no capacity is exceeded and at least one resource remains partially unallocated, and false otherwise

v2_human_g3_goal: The goal of the system is to determine whether a set of resource requests on is feasible without exceeding available capacity although while still having one resource with some available space
v2_human_g3_input:
- a dictionary mapping resource names to numeric capacities
- a list of dictionaries mapping resource names to numeric request amounts

v2_human_g3_neg.neg_req_1: The system shall not report an allocation as feasible if all resources are fully consumed
v2_human_g3_neg.neg_req_2: The system shall not attempt to partially satisfy request when determining feasibility

v2_human_g3_output: - boolean value whether the allocation is feasible or not
v2_human_g3_tb: The system does not currently prioritize or choose between scenarios, it just determines feasibility. If it had to it should be outlined on whether it should be determined. One possible way is prioritizing the allocation with most unused resources

v2_humang3_invariants.inv_1: For every resource, the amount allocated shall never exceed that resource's capacity
v2_humang3_invariants.inv_2: Given the same set of available resources and requests, the function shall always return the same result
v2_humang3_invariants.inv_3: A feasible allocation must always have at least one resource with some remaining capacity
